caption: The drawing depicts a single metal bell affixed to a bracket. The bell is conical in shape with a rounded lip at the bottom and appears to be made of a bronze or brass-colored metal with subtle shading to show its three-dimensional form. Attached to the bell is a curved handle or mount that forms an arc above and around the bell, connecting to a straight horizontal arm secured with a visible bolt or rivet at one end. This arm is a rusty reddish-brown color, suggesting aged iron or steel. The entire bell and mounting assembly is set against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The lines and colors are rendered with smooth gradients and careful attention to contours and texture.
title: Servant's Bell
